FAQ

Selling surplus aluminum foil rolls

What aluminum foil rolls do you buy?

We buy rolls of bare, lacquered and laminated aluminum foil. That includes uncoated coils, paper and polymer laminates, lid stock, pouch stock, blister and cold form foil, and production scrap. If it's foil on a core, we want to hear about it.

Which industries do your foil rolls come from?

As roll buyers, we work with foil importers, distributors and laminators, flexible packaging converters and slitters, food and beverage packers (heat seal lids, pouches, butter and candy wrap) and pharmaceutical packagers (blister lidding and pouch).

Do you buy damaged, rejected or overrun foil rolls?

Yes. We buy surplus rolls that are overstock, outdated, rejected or damaged. Tell us what happened to the rolls and we'll tell you what we can offer.

Can you destroy printed foil and laminates?

Yes. If your printed foil or laminate carries a brand or sensitive design, we can guarantee its destruction instead of reselling it.

How do I sell my surplus aluminum foil rolls?

Call or email us with a description or specs, the gross weight on hand and your pick-up location. Photos help. We'll send you a proposal, simple as that.

How fast can you pick up?

We buy rolls in full and partial trailer loads across North America, and can usually have a truck at your warehouse within 48 to 72 hours.
